cd /workspace && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native PYTHONPATH=/workspace/vendor:/workspace/submission python3 -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import planner, json
fx = json.loads(open('/workspace/examples/checks.json').read())[1]

print('potential', r['potential'])
print('nodes', fx['nodes'], 'arcs', fx['arcs'], 'got', len(r['potential']), len(r['flow']))
